Songwriting & production

I've had a long and, some might say, chequered history with songwriting and, latterly, producing music. I work out of my spare room from a full-equipped home/project studio. I tend towards guitars and drums as my main focus then add everything else in... Blah, blah. Let's go on a journey through the years together...

2022

The Guise project

Me and my old mate Jim worked together for years in bands. When that wasn't feasible any more (due to kids & living at different ends of the country) we tried our hands at simply writing an EP/mini album together. We had a lot of material in the end which I curated into a 'record' (remember those?). We're quite different in our tastes which did bring a certain frisson to the stuff I actually produced, lots of back and forth.

This is really the start of my production journey proper, I had no real clue what I was doing, so played it rather safe (where has the bottom end gone?).

2023
